speak: 图的深度优先遍历，先记一句口诀：不撞南墙不回头。

subs.en: Depth-first search on a graph.

subs.text: 先记一句口诀：不撞南墙不回头。
subs.en: One rule to remember: don't turn back until you hit a wall.

speak: 也叫一条道走到黑：能往前就往前，走不动了才退一步。

subs.en: Or: follow one road all the way.

subs.text: 能往前就往前，走不动了才退一步。
subs.en: Keep moving forward; step back only when you're stuck.

speak: 目标是每个顶点访问一次。拿教材这张图，从V一出发。

subs.text: 目标：每个顶点访问一次。
subs.en: Goal: visit every vertex exactly once.
Take graph G_{4} from the textbook and start at v_{1}.

speak: 右边两样东西：visited数组，记谁来过；递归栈，记一路走过来的顶点。

subs.en: Two things on the right:
the visited array: who has been visited;

subs.text: 递归栈，记一路走过来的顶点。
subs.en: the recursion stack: the vertices on the way here.

speak: 访问V一：visited记上，压进栈，写进序列。

subs.text: 访问v_{1}：visited记上，压进栈，写进序列。
subs.en: Visit v_{1}: mark it, push it, write it down.

speak: V一的邻接点有V二、V三，先挑小的，走V二。

subs.en: v_{1} has two neighbors, v_{2} and v_{3}.
Take the smaller number first: go to v_{2}.

speak: 到了V二，V一来过了，跳过，走V四。

subs.en: At v_{2}: v_{1} is visited, skip it, go to v_{4}.

speak: 一条道走到黑：V四到V八，V八到V五。

subs.en: All the way down: v_{4} to v_{8}, v_{8} to v_{5}.

speak: 到了V五，邻居V二、V八都来过了。

subs.en: At v_{5}: neighbors v_{2} and v_{8} are both visited.

speak: 没有新路，这就是撞南墙。

subs.text: 没有新路，这就是撞南墙。
subs.en: No new road. That's the wall.

speak: 那就回头：沿着来的那条边退回V八，V五出栈。

subs.en: So turn back:

subs.text: 沿着来的那条边退回v_{8}，v_{5}出栈。
subs.en: back along the edge you came by, to v_{8}. v_{5} is popped.

speak: 注意栈顶：它就是你现在站的顶点，所以出栈，就是往回退一步。

subs.text: 注意栈顶：它就是你现在站的顶点，
subs.en: Look at the top of the stack: it's where you stand,

subs.text: 所以出栈，就是往回退一步。
subs.en: so popping it means one step back.

speak: V八也没新路，退回V四；V四也没有，退回V二。

subs.en: No new road from v_{8}: back to v_{4}.
None from v_{4} either: back to v_{2}.

speak: V二剩下的V五来过了，再退回V一。

subs.en: v_{2}'s last neighbor v_{5} is visited. Back to v_{1}.

speak: V一还有V三没去，走V三，再到V六、V七。

subs.en: v_{1} still has v_{3}. Go to v_{3},
then v_{6} and v_{7}.

speak: V七走不通，一路退回V一，栈空了，遍历结束。

subs.en: Dead end at v_{7}. Back all the way to v_{1}.
The stack is empty: done.

speak: 访问序列：V一、V二、V四、V八、V五、V三、V六、V七。
刚才先挑编号小的。换成先挑大的，再走一遍。

subs.en: Last time we took the smaller number first.

subs.text: 换成先挑大的，再走一遍。
subs.en: Now take the larger one first, and run it again.

speak: V一、V三、V七、V六，退回V一，再走V二、V五、V八、V四。
两条都对，DFS序列不唯一。这张图从V一出发，一共有八种。

subs.en: Both are correct: a DFS order is not unique.

subs.text: 这张图从v_{1}出发，一共有8种。
subs.en: From v_{1}, this graph has 8 of them.

speak: 那考试怎么考？题目会给定存储结构，比如邻接表。

subs.en: So how do exams ask it?

subs.text: 题目会给定存储结构，比如邻接表。
subs.en: They fix the storage, for example an adjacency list.

speak: 每个顶点挂一条链，记着邻接点的下标。

subs.text: 每个顶点挂一条链，记着邻接点的下标。
subs.en: Each vertex has a linked list of its neighbors' indices.

speak: 沿着链从前往后找，第一个没来过的就去。

subs.text: 沿着链从前往后找，第一个没来过的就去。
subs.en: Walk the list from the front; go to the first unvisited one.

speak: 每一步都定死了，序列唯一，就是第一条。

subs.text: 每一步都定死了，序列唯一，就是第一条。
subs.en: Every step is fixed: one order only, the first one.

speak: 链倒过来，走出来就是第二条。所以表一给定，答案就唯一，考研考的就是这个。

subs.text: 链倒过来，走出来就是第二条。
subs.en: Reverse the lists, and you get the second order.

subs.text: 所以表一给定，答案就唯一，
subs.en: Once the list is given, the answer is unique.
That's what the exams test.

speak: 图要是不连通呢？从V一出发，只走得完这一块。

subs.en: What if the graph isn't connected?

subs.text: 从v_{1}出发，只走得完这一块。
subs.en: From v_{1}, you only cover its own piece.

speak: 所以外面套一层循环：没访问过的顶点，再调一次DFS。

subs.en: So wrap it in a loop:

subs.text: 没访问过的顶点，再调一次DFS。
subs.en: for each unvisited vertex, call DFS again.

speak: 调几次DFS，就有几个连通分量：这里三次，孤立的V六也算一个。

subs.text: 调几次DFS，就有几个连通分量：
subs.en: Number of DFS calls = number of connected components:

subs.text: 这里3次，孤立的v_{6}也算一个。
subs.en: here, 3. The lone v_{6} counts as one.

speak: 复杂度：时间花在找邻接点上。

subs.text: 复杂度：时间花在找邻接点上。
subs.en: Cost: the time goes into finding neighbors.

speak: 邻接矩阵每次扫一整行，O n平方；邻接表只扫边结点，O n加e。

subs.text: 邻接矩阵每次扫一整行：O(n²)；
subs.en: Adjacency matrix: a whole row each time, O(n²).
Adjacency list: only the edge nodes, O(n+e).

speak: 最后一题：下面哪个不是从V一出发的DFS序列？给你八秒。

subs.en: Last question:

subs.text: 下面哪个不是从v_{1}出发的DFS序列？
subs.en: which one is NOT a DFS order starting from v_{1}?
You have 8 seconds.

speak: 答案是C。走到V四时，V八还没来过，只能去V八，跳不到V五。

subs.en: The answer is C.
At v_{4}, v_{8} is still unvisited,
so the next step must be v_{8}, not v_{5}.

speak: 一条道走到黑，走不通就退一步。下期，我们讲BFS。

subs.text: 一条道走到黑，走不通就退一步。
subs.en: Go as deep as you can; when stuck, step back.
Next time: breadth-first search.
